title: Young Boy Playing in Backyard Lawn, c. 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white candid snapshot capturing a young toddler standing on a grassy lawn in a suburban or rural backyard. The child wears light-colored clothing and holds a small ball near his chest. Laundry hangs drying on an outdoor line in the background alongside a metal wash basin on the grass, exemplifying post-World War II domestic family life in mid-20th century America.
